verdict.rationale: Viam ships a dedicated 'use Viam from an agent' doc describing how an AI agent with a shell or SDK can drive a machine via JSON-in/JSON-out CLI calls, query resource status, and invoke motion planning — enabling an agent to translate natural-language intent into machine actions. However, there is no evidence of a built-in natural-language parser or chat-style command interface; the agent must already convert NL to API/CLI calls itself. missing for 10: a native NL command layer, first-party NLU/chatbot integration, and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent successfully operates a machine end-to-end from plain-language input.
